thread:
ania: Heads-up — I want to start a 'cohesion harvest' to reduce churn from many tiny services and centralize common adapters into a platform library. Long horizon: 2–3 quarters. RFC follow-up notes coming.
sam: Nice. Do you have a metric to scope candidates? QPS, owners, alert volume?
mike: +1 on scoping. We should avoid touching hotpaths without a safety net.
lee: For candidates, I'd query call graphs and ownership. low QPS + single owner + <3 alerts in 90d seems reasonable.
ania: Agreed. Draft criteria (quick):
```
- QPS < 1 req/s avg over 30d
- Owners <= 1 team
- Active alerts < 3 in last 90d
- No direct model-serving hotpath calls
```
sarah: Risk note: some small services still contain custom auth/tenant logic. Those need extraction plan rather than deletion.
ania: Yep — we'll classify candidates into: merge-to-platform, extract-shared, or archive. Different rollout for each.
infra-bot: automated-scan: found 47 potential candidates matching initial heuristics. list: infra-task-102, enrich-legacy-3, sidecar-lite, auth-shim-old ...
sam: Can infra-bot attach call graph heatmap and recent deploy frequency? That helps pick low-risk ones.
infra-bot: attached -> call-heatmap.svg, deploy-history.csv
mike: Proposal: 3-phase approach: audit (2w), pilot merge (1 team, 2 services, 4w), staged migration w/ canaries (8w).
lee: Also add a tracing tag and feature-flag for each merge to keep rollback simple: `X-service-cohesion`.
ania: Planning a 2-week spike mid-May to validate migration pattern and measure perf delta. Volunteers: @mike @lee @sarah
sarah: I'll own the extraction plan for auth-shim-old — need to preserve tenant semantics. :+1:
sam: Can we tie this to cost OKR? Even 10% infra drop for small services would be impactful.
ania: I've back-of-envelope: centralizing shared runtimes + fewer warm containers => ~12–18% savings for the service pool. Will produce a short impact calc.
mike: Don't forget SLIs. Add latency p95 and error-rate buckets to the pilot dashboards.
lee: Also include automated rollback test in the canary pipeline: `make rollback-test` should exercise fallback.
ania: Will add rollout playbook and a runbook snippet. Example rollback command we plan to document:
```
# rollback to previous artifact
redwood-deploy rollback --service=auth-shim-old --to=artifact@2025-04-20
```
sarah: One more ops ask: keep feature flags per-tenant for the first 4 weeks.
ania: noted. I'll post the RFC follow-up tomorrow with audit links, infra-bot outputs, and a proposed timeline.
sam: Thanks — happy to review the RFC. :clap:
mike: Count me in for the spike. :rocket:
ania: Great — capturing action items in the RFC. We'll sync in the architecture weekly to triage the candidate list.
